steps.title: Setup - Fetch PurchaseDate from GetSubscriptionOrder API for SO193677

S43 - Past date (today-2) rejected with "Date entered cannot be before current date."
S40 - Error clears after entering a valid (today) date
S37 - Start date > 180 days from PurchaseDate (purchase+181) rejected with "Date cannot exceed 180 days..."
S36 - Start date purchase+179 days is accepted (no error) + end = start + 1 yr - 1 day
S39 - End date reflects 1-year-out when start date changes (today+4)
S38 - Clearing start date clears the end date input value
S42 - "Abandon Activation and Log-out" redirects to login page
